Every American deserves access to health care. The open enrollment period on https://t.co/sFVmZDUpYU began today, and thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act, Marketplace coverage is more affordable than ever. If you lack health insurance, click here to see which plan is for you.

Medicare Open Enrollment is open until December 7. If you’re 65 or older and would like to enroll in a plan or switch your insurance, visit https://t.co/kgVclKoXhu to explore different options. The Inflation Reduction Act has strengthened Medicare benefits for seniors.

The Inflation Reduction Act lowered drug costs for people on Medicare. It capped the price of insulin at $35 and out-of-pocket prescription drug costs at $2,000 per year. Seniors deserve affordable health care, and we’ll never stop fighting to secure it for them.
